title: Delete Line (dd)
instruction_text:
Delete entire lines with 'dd'!

Your task: Remove the lines with uppercase text.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to the 'DELETE ME' line
2. Press 'dd' (deletes entire line)
3. Move to 'REMOVE THIS' line
4. Press 'dd' again
5. Save and quit with :wq

Result should be just:
Apple
Banana
Cherry
